CustomField.label: Qualification Region
CustomField.description: CR-15 product availability in Browse Products (product discovery context attribute MB_Region__c). US48 = United States excluding Alaska and Hawaii (Insurance); otherwise the account Region (NA, UK, AU, EU).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Decides which region-limited products (hardware, Capital, Insurance) this account can buy. Set from Region and billing country / state.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(MB_Region__c, 'NA'), OR(UPPER(TRIM(BillingCountry)) = 'US', UPPER(TRIM(BillingCountry)) = 'USA', UPPER(TRIM(BillingCountry)) = 'UNITED STATES', UPPER(TRIM(BillingCountry)) = 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA'), NOT(OR(UPPER(TRIM(BillingState)) = 'AK', UPPER(TRIM(BillingState)) = 'ALASKA', UPPER(TRIM(BillingState)) = 'HI', UPPER(TRIM(BillingState)) = 'HAWAII')) ), 'US48', TEXT(MB_Region__c) )
